answer:
I changed the accent color in your Habit tracker's app from orange to green (#2e9e4f). That covers the completed checks, the filled squares in the history grid, the streak counts, the "done today" text and the outline on today's square.

I also set the tick mark inside the checks to plain white so it stays visible on the green. I didn't run the app's check or look at a preview, so give it a quick look on the App side. Your note's text and data are unchanged, and the earlier version of the app is saved if you want it back.
